title: Consolidate the PIN entry/verify/change/setup state machine duplicated across 3 live implementations in features/profiles
rule: SM-1/Fowler duplication, AG-4 duplicate top-level names
why: The 4-digit-entry + busy-lock + lockout state machine is hand-rolled independently in PinFlowController (setup mode), _ParentPinSetupDialog (parent_pin_setup_dialog.dart), and _ParentPinVerificationDialog/_ParentPinChangeDialog (parent_pin_keypad_dialog.dart) — four near-identical but textually distinct copies of the same transitions (mismatch → reset to enterNew, lockout → freeze keypad, 4th digit → async verify/save). Worse, PinFlowController ALSO fully implements change/verify modes (and pin_flow_machine.dart even duplicates the enum names PinFlowMode/PinFlowStep as public top-level symbols, AG-4), but grepping every `.push(` call site in lib/ shows PinFlowVerifyRoute and PinFlowChangeRoute are registered in app_router.dart and never pushed anywhere — the app's real verify/change UX goes through the dialog-based _ParentPin*Dialog classes via router_provider.dart's promptForPin and settings_screen.dart. A confirmed device bug (PP-1: rapid 5th-digit tap racing the confirm-step reset) was fixed in _ParentPinSetupDialog's specific busy-before-reset ordering; because the other three copies re-derive the same logic independently, a fix like this has no guarantee of applying to the others.
recommendation: Extract one shared PIN-entry state-machine class/notifier (digits, busy, lockedOut, lockoutMinutes, transitions) and have setup/verify/change dialogs and PinFlowScreen all delegate to it; delete PinFlowController's unreachable change/verify branches and their dead routes, or wire a real navigation call site to them.
acceptance_criteria: Only one implementation owns the digit-buffer/busy/lockout transition logic; setup, verify, and change UIs all call into it
Either PinFlowVerifyRoute/PinFlowChangeRoute get a real .push call site, or they and PinFlowController's change/verify modes are deleted
pin_flow_controller_test.dart and parent_pin_keypad_dialog_test.dart continue to pass against the consolidated implementation
